standards.name: MO§ES Ecosystem Standard
standards.role: Canonical public architecture and reference standard for the entire MO§ES ecosystem. Governed projection of Search Authority.
standards.description: The canonical public architecture and reference standard for the entire MO§ES ecosystem. A governed public projection of the Search Authority master canon. Does not independently invent canonical truth — every claim traces to Search Authority. References MO§ES Framework, TTEOP, and Ello Control without redefining them.

standards.name: TTEOP
standards.role: Sole interoperability protocol authority for token telemetry measurement.
standards.description: Token Telemetry Evaluation Operator Protocol. Open, vendor-neutral interoperability standard for measuring AI-operator token efficiency. Sole protocol authority for telemetry schemas, formulas, null semantics, privacy, provenance, and conformance. Legacy alias sigrank/0.1-draft resolves to tteop/0.1-draft.

standards.name: sigrank-standard (legacy)
standards.role: Legacy predecessor — compatibility and migration evidence only.
standards.description: Legacy predecessor of TTEOP. Original sigrank/0.1-draft measurement specification. Retained for migration evidence, historical provenance, and backward compatibility alias resolution. Superseded by TTEOP (tteop/0.1-draft). Do not use as primary conformance authority.
